result.description: A fictional compact USB-C audio interface designed for podcasters, mobile musicians, and streamers who need a simple two-input recording rig on the go. It features 24-bit / 96 kHz conversion, two combo mic/line inputs with independent gain, direct monitoring, and a balanced headphone output. The unit is bus-powered, includes a small loopback mode for livestream mixing, and ships in a matte graphite enclosure sized for travel bags and desktop setups alike.
result.title: Nebula Arc 14 Portable Audio Interface
